sql: SELECT split_part(market_ticker,'-',1) AS series, count(*) AS n, count(*) FILTER (WHERE pnl<0) AS losses, round(sum(pnl)::numeric,2) AS pnl, round(avg(assumed_price)::numeric,1) AS px, count(DISTINCT split_part(market_ticker,'-',2)) AS games, count(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '30 days') AS n30, min(created_at)::date AS first FROM paper_trades WHERE status IN ('settled','closed_sl') AND strategy LIKE '%mmsell%' AND strategy NOT LIKE '%\_pt%' AND (market_ticker LIKE 'KXNCAAF%' OR market_ticker LIKE 'KXNFL%' OR market_ticker LIKE 'KXCFB%') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
